viewContainer.title: REDAXO
welcome.noDocker:
Docker is not running.
Start Docker Desktop (or another Docker runtime) – this view updates automatically.
[Install Docker](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/get-docker/)
welcome.empty:
No instances yet. A REDAXO instance is ready in about a minute.
[New Instance](command:redaxo-instances.createInstance)
[Import Instance](command:redaxo-instances.importInstance)
New here? Read the [Getting Started](command:redaxo-instances.openWalkthrough) guide.
Help and documentation: [Help](command:redaxo-instances.showHelp)
config.dockerPath: Docker executable – only change it when `docker` is not in your PATH.

walkthrough.title: Get started with REDAXO instances
walkthrough.description: From zero to a running REDAXO with HTTPS in a few minutes.
walkthrough.docker.title: Docker is running
walkthrough.docker.description: Instances run in Docker. Install and start [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/) (or OrbStack, Colima, Docker Engine). This step completes automatically as soon as Docker is reachable.
walkthrough.create.title: Create your first instance
walkthrough.create.description:
Enter a name, choose REDAXO – done. REDAXO is installed automatically and opens at https://<name>.localhost.
[New Instance](command:redaxo-instances.createInstance)
walkthrough.https.title: Trusted HTTPS (recommended)
walkthrough.https.description:
With [mkcert](https://github.com/FiloSottile/mkcert) the browser trusts the local certificates of all instances and extra domains – no warnings, no hosts file.
[Trust Certificates](command:redaxo-instances.trustCertificates)
walkthrough.ai.title: Work with AI
walkthrough.ai.description:
Copilot: ask **@redaxo** in the chat or use the redaxo tools in agent mode. Claude Code / Claude Desktop: connect the MCP server once. Every instance contains an AGENTS.md with all facts for AI assistants.
[Connect Claude](command:redaxo-instances.setupClaude)
walkthrough.redaxo6.title: Try REDAXO 6
walkthrough.redaxo6.description:
Choose "REDAXO 6" in the wizard for a Composer project of the development version, or "REDAXO 6 Core" to clone redaxo/core and contribute.
[New Instance](command:redaxo-instances.createInstance)
chat.description: Manage your REDAXO instances – ask anything or use /list, /console, /query …
